name: Upcoming TV Radar
description: Find one not-yet-emailed upcoming TV series that matches a required genre request, enrich it with TMDB metadata and current public-web context, maintain a rolling Canvas page for the resolved primary genre, and optionally email the pick with a public TMDB poster URL. Sent-show history remains shared across genres. Example: /upcoming_tv_radar science fiction, exclude animation and anime, next 90 days, email me the pick.

variables.tmdb_attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

steps.description: Get the TV radar run timestamp
Open the persistent sent-show history space shared across all radar genres
Load TMDB TV IDs that any genre schedule has already emailed

steps.abort_speech: Upcoming TV Radar needs a recognized included genre and an available TMDB series match. Try a request such as science fiction, exclude animation and anime, next 90 days.
steps.description: Discover upcoming TMDB TV premieres with provider-side genre exclusion and persistent sent-ID filtering
Find the durable Upcoming TV Radar Canvas page for the resolved primary genre
Enrich the selected series with cast, creators, networks, production, seasons, artwork, and videos

params.query: Current verified reporting about the upcoming TV series ${top_title} ${top_year}: premiere timing, network or platform, production, principal cast, audience or critic discussion, and announced US streaming availability. Preference request: ${show_criteria}

steps.description: Optionally enrich the selected series with current public-web reporting
Create the durable Canvas page for this primary TV genre on its first run
Refresh this primary TV genre's durable radar page as a bounded full replacement
Optionally email the selected series with its public TMDB poster and destination URL

steps.abort_speech: The TV radar email was sent, but Jarvis could not record ${top_title} in the sent-history ledger. Do not rerun the email workflow until the Stash acknowledgement is repaired, or it may send the same series again.
steps.description: Acknowledge the TMDB TV ID only after the email webhook reports sent

success_speech: Upcoming TV Radar complete. ${top_title} is the latest eligible ${primary_radar_genre} premiere, and that genre's rolling Canvas page is current.
partial_speech: Upcoming TV Radar completed with the TMDB and optional enrichment sources that were available. Check the ${primary_radar_genre} Canvas page for ${top_title}; if email was requested, verify the email webhook result.
abort_speech: Upcoming TV Radar could not find an eligible result. Include a recognized genre such as science fiction, make sure TMDB is configured, or widen the future first-air window.
